FULL TEXT:
ADVERTISEMENT FOR POST OF A PROJECT ASSOCIATE
Applications on a plain paper with the detailed bio-data and attested copies of all certificates/
testimonials, as per the following qualifications, are invited for one (01) post of a Project
Associate under the National Network Project of NIPER, Mohali sanctioned by DBT. (No.
BT/PR40226/BTIS/137/66/2023)
Essential Qualification: -
Masters Degree in Life sciences, Bioinformatics or Pharmacy from a recognised university or
equivalent
Proposed Emolument: -
i) Rs 31,000/-stipend to scholars who are selected through National Eligibility Tests-CSIR
UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) or GATE or GPAT
ii) Rs 25,000/- stipend for others who do don't fall under (i) above
(iii) Emolument shall be applicable only if candidate(s) meets qualification and eligibility
criteria
Experience -
1) Analysis of molecular data from biological systems
2) Metabolomics data analysis.
3) Data Management
The complete application along with Bio-data, certificates/testimonials and experience
details/proof should reach the undersigned, preferably by e-mail, latest by 20 th April 2024
The interview for the said post will be conducted in the Centre for Systems Biology &
Bioinformatics, South Campus Sector-25, Panjab University, Chandigarh. Shortlisted
candidates will be informed for the interview by email.
The selected candidate shall be governed by DBT and/or Panjab University rules and
regulations.
Veena Puri
Principal Investigator
Research Project
Associate. Professor, Centre for Systems Biology & Bioinformatics Panjab University,
Chandigarh-160014 Email: vpuri1825@pu.ac.in
